property_description: Pacifc Corporate Plaza is located in the 900-acre workplace community of Pacific Park in South Orange County. The property includes three, two-story technology buildings totaling almost 130,000 square feet. Property features include: Floor-to-floor heights of 15 feet, large, flexible floorplates, steel frame second floor with metal deck, floor load capacity of 100ibs/sf live load, shell space still available and variable volume HVAC system. The abundant amenities enhancing Pacific Corporate Plaza includes views of the Saddleback Valley and Mountain ranges in the distance and proximity to the recently completed San Joaquin Tollway, John Wayne Airport and the executive housing and destination retail of Newport Beach. Additionally, a fitness center, hiking and bicycle trails, and numerous shops and restaruants are all within walking distance.
Office condo with a private patio. 5 private offices, large conference room, open area and break room with sink. Furniture available.
